name: start-registration-ordering
body: The start registry refusal runs after the git-collision refusals, so a live branch or worktree duplicate still reports the git-state wording while the row wording covers only the stale-row case; and the row is written after worktree creation, so a failed registry write leaves the new worktree and branch in place. Reorder the refusal and add post-creation rollback when either ordering becomes user-visible.
